programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On November 9, 2011, the body of a man was found near the Courcelles-le-Comte cemetery (Pas-de-Calais).

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to 16-year-old Karine Schaaff is found abandoned on the side of a road in Moselle; 10 days later her body is found just kilometers away, hidden in a forest.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear; there are many theories surrounding this mysterious case.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest; the police are perplexed by the clues found at the crime scene and the state of the body which is missing both the head and heart.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year-old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a car accident while on his honeymoon; Marc's wife, Aurore, isn't injured in the accident and the case is quickly dismissed; Marc's family is suspicious of Aurore.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 52-year-old Marina Ciampi is found dead at her home in Marseille; she is found naked on her bed with a plastic bag over her head, but there is no trace of a break-in; police investigate several unknown DNA traces.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On 1 December 2005, Dominique Aubry, a wealthy widow, is found hanged in her houseboat in Neuilly; the case is quickly classified as a suicide, but this argument is problematic.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente are called to a fire at a large house in the village; they arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, 83-year-old Claude Tavernier, lying in a large pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 18-year-old Laetitia Perrais is a trainee hotel waitress who vanishes after an evening shift; every attempt is made to shed light on her disappearance and the efforts eventually pay off.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending "Teknival" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written "DIRTY RAPIST". Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of a four year old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On October 13th 1996, the body of young Angélique Dumetz, 18 years old, is recovered down a ditch in Oise forest. An important clue is found on the crime scene.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself? Clues will help investigators to see in between the subterfuges and lies, leading them to the terrible truth.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Become NatureWise"

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "The Tuscan Boar"
programme.desc: Discover a master knife maker, pursue wild boar in the hills, and experience the charm of an award-winning castle.

programme.title: Loaded S1 - "Turkey Truckin’"
programme.desc: Joe’s bees run low on fuel in the desert. Ryan hauls a wide load through a whiteout, and Brenda fights holiday traffic to get home.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "SUMMER"
programme.desc: This time of year is usually a time for commercial fishermen to think about vacation but due to a poor spring, Mike, Tim, Jedd and their crews are fishing well into summer.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "NEW BEGINNINGS IN AUTUMN"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 NEW BEGINNINGS IN AUTUMN
programme.desc: As the season changes from summer to fall, change is also in store for our commercial fishermen. One man is just starting out, one is barely getting by, and one is looking to start over.

programme.title: Wardens S3 - "Summer Recreation"
programme.desc: Wardens from Region 2 stay completely hands-on near Seeley Lake, Montana, as they deal with a massive summer recreation crowd.

programme.title: Wardens S3 - "Rocky Mountain Front"
programme.desc: During a busy hunting season, wardens catch poachers using an elk decoy, track down trespassers, and perform routine tag checks.

programme.title: Wardens S3 - "Check Point"
programme.desc: Montana wardens saddle up for backcountry patrol against poachers, handle illegal anglers, and cite an elderly man feeding prohibited deer.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "ATV Accidents"
programme.desc: ATVs have allowed us to penetrate the wilderness like never before. But they’ve also made the backcountry a bit more dangerous. Laura and Nick rig up some dramatic, high-speed tests to see how accidents happen and what you can do to protect yourself.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Bear Attack"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Surviving a Bear Attack
programme.desc: Nick and Laura create kick-ass tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears. They use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Then try to recreate a “miracle” arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving Treestand Accidents"
programme.desc: In this exciting episode we’ll find out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how we can prevent them. Cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send our hosts, our stunt team and our special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

programme.desc: Gary og sønnen finder en gammel militærlastbil, men det er hårdt at køre den op til minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Garon og Josh mister kontrollen over Six Pack på de mudrede stier.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Justin flyver ind med en ny sav, men mister tålmodigheden, da han forsøger at sætte den op.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændinger opstår under teamets kamp for at transportere tungt udstyr op ad en mudret, klippefyldt, 120 km lang sti for at etablere en ny jade-mine på bjergtoppen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet forsøger at få deres maskiner transportet over kraftigt stigende floder for at etablere deres nye jademine på en bjergtop.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Alan er overbevist om, at der er jade under en grube, der fyldt med vand, kaldet Dynasty.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Robin forsøger at trodse fysikkens love for at få et stort, nyt mandskabsrum til deres Wolverine-mine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: En række uheld forfølger Jade City-holdet, og alle forsøger at finder unikke løsninger på problermerne.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændingerne koger over, da de oversøiske investorer dukker uventet op for at tjekke fremskridtet i Wolverine-minen, og Alan forsøger at skabe fred.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Efter endelig at have afdækket nogle lovende klippestykker ved Wolverine-minen, opdager teamet, at de måske har overtrådt minens grænser.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Stressniveauet stiger i takt med at afslutningen på mine-sæsonen nærmer sig, og Jade City-teamet forsøger at finde den store jade-gevinst.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Temperaturer under frysepunktet udfordrer Jade City-minearbejderne, der kæmper for at finde jackpotten-en jade-klippe stor nok til at imponere investorerne-inden sæsonen slutter.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia og Robins uprøvede maskiner begynder at bryde sammen under den brutale tur op til Wolverine-minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet forsøger at krydse svulmende floder, for at få deres maskiner op til minen, mens Josh falder bagud i sin gravemaskine, der konstant har problemer.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Minensæsonen starter, og mens jaden viser sig at være svær at finde, bringer en lastbilulykke held til Jade City.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Guy bliver efterladt med ansvaret for Wolverine-minen, hvor introduktionen af en ny arbejder truer med at ødelægge hans mission om at finde sæsonens første jade.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Mens Wolverine-teamet strammer op på deres sikkerhedsprocedurer, kollapser den nye medarbejder, Jay, hvilket afslører problemerne i deres nødberedskab.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Josh er strandet i den nye gravemaskine, mens en bunke værdiløse klippestykker får Claudia til at overveje en ny strategi.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Alan bringer en gruppe købere til Jade City, hvilket får Claudias team til at gå i panik i deres forsøg på at finde sæsonens første salgbare jade-klippestykker.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet finder sæsonens bedste jade-klippe, men risikerer at underminere dens værdi, da de forsøger at fjerne alle revnerne.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudias søn Justin viser, at han har næse for jade, mens Scrappy Larry, Robin og Josh kæmper for at få deres ødelagte lastbil væk fra stien til Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: En række skuffelser tvinger Robin og Justin på en sidste desperat jagt efter jade-klippestykker for at redde sæsonen, mens Scrappy Larry skynder sig for at få en dieseltank ombygget.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudias projekt med at huse et arbejdshold i Jade City er truet, da septiktanken bryder sammen og forurener drikkevandet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Det kolde vejr starter tidligt og gælden hober sig op, mens teamet kæmper for at få en enorm og potentielt sæson-reddende klippe transporteret hen til lejren.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Kapløbet er i gang for at komme ud af Wolverine-lejren, inden sneen begraver det hele.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia bliver tvunget til at køre lastbilen, mens hendes hold kæmper sig op ad den stenede sti til deres bjergtop-jadelejr, Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændingerne koger over, da Claudia, Robin og teamet forsøger at få mennesker og udstyr til deres fjerntliggende jade-lejr.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia og Robin forsøger at imponere deres nye forretningspartnere, men de første dage på deres nye mine Bullion Creek, er frustrerende.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Sæsonens første store klippe bringes tilbage til lejren og savearbejdet går igang.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Justin gør krav på et nyt område, efter at han snubler over et fantastisk jadefund, men andre minefolk er også interesseret.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Efter at have brudt med sine forretningspartnere, skynder Claudia og Robin sig at genoptage minedriften ved Wolverine, men bliver stoppet af en overraskelse.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet kæmper for at få gang i Dynasty-jadebruddet trods defekt udstyr.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Justin og Mike kæmper med revner og hinanden for at bevise at deres metoder virker over for de utålmodige investorer.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Alan vender tilbage fra Kina og fortæller Justin og Mike de ubehagelige sandheder om den mine, de forsøger at udvide.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Justin og Mike kæmper sig gennem sne og is for at nå hen til den potentielt værdifyldte jadeklippe - Big Fin.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia finanserer selv minesæsonen og er fast besluttet på at starte jagten på jaden en måned tidligere, da sne og højvande forhindrer teamet i at fortsætte og tvinger Claudia til at genoverveje hendes strategi.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Robin følger en mavefornemmelse til et nyt sted på et gammelt mineområde, mens Joshs' høje forventninger og korte lunte tester Garys tålmodighed.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Guy kæmper med gravemaskinen for at blotlægge et enormt fund, mens Joshs' utilfredshed med hans rolle i teamet får familiekonflikterne til at koge over.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Holdet står over for en farlig redningsaktion på bredden ved Turnagain-floden.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Bearbejdelsen af et potentielt værdifuldt fund sættes på pause, da gammelt udstyr fejler.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Arbejdet starter endelig på den gigantiske jadeklippe ved Dynasty, men store revner bringer projektet i fare.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Da en vigtig jade-køber ikke er imponeret over Pit 3-linsen, tvinges Claudia til at træffe en svær beslutning, der skuffer hendes hold.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Kapløbet for at lukke lejren ned ved Wolverine bliver til et mareridt, da varme, sygdom og en skovbrand rammer teamet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Den brutale rejse til en ny mineområde adskiller familien og presser Josh til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia er ivrig efter at påbegynde arbejdet på det nye sted, men arbejet bliver forsinket af en række uheldige hændelser i deres gamle minerlejr, Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Lidt forkælelse i lejren opmuntrer et utilfreds mandskab, og uventede gæster giver Claudia håb for hendes fremtid ved 2 Mile.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Mandskabet har endelig heldet med sig, men med vinteren lige om hjørnet, er Claudia bekymret for, at fundet måske er kommet for sent.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia er desperat efter at starte minedriften, men de brutale vejforhold får hende til at tvivle på, om teamet overhovedet vil nå frem til minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Mens Guy og Gary kæmper for at reparere den ødelagte vej til minen, håber Claudia, at en ny medarbejder vil bringe det held, hun desperat har brug for.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Robins uventede indkøbstur stresser Claudia, da hans misforståelser forsinker deres minesæson.

programme.desc: Claudia forsøger at bevare freden da Robin og hendes far kommer op og toppes, mens teamet kæmper med at løse det ene problem efter det andet med deres minevogn.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændingerne koger over mellem Robin, Josh og Steve om, hvordan de skal mine, og da Claudia blander sig, går det helt galt.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Plaget af lastbilproblemer, kæmper Robin og hans team for at få en brændstofkørsel overstået, før udstyret løber tør.

programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: It's all about pork and peanuts, today's challenge is the letter "P." Chef Lauren Gulyas serves up an old school favourite, smothered pork chops. Using a blend of savoury ingredients, and with the help of her cast iron pan, Chef Lauren provides us with tips on how to keep your pork tender and tasty. Next, it's time for a West African peanut soup. Drizzling garlic, ginger and onions with extra virgin olive oil and letting them sizzle in a frying pan until the onions are soft brings out a sweetness that lends itself beautifully to the salty, earthy taste of peanuts. To finish, Chef Lauren puts an Asian twist on a southern classic, when she combines the two ingredients.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition; outside, over the fire, on a beautiful sunny day!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 The Butter Did It
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: We've all cooked with salt. But what about ON salt. That's right, chef Spencer Watts blows our minds with his seared scallops that are cooked on a Himalayan pink salt block. His next recipe uses a quick cure with Hawaiian black lava salt on swordfish steaks, then tops them with a gorgeous and refreshing grilled fruit salsa. Then, Spencer gets creative with Cured Duck Legs with Scallions, using a salt cure to intensify the flavours of duck leg before it's cooked slow and low, then glazed with maple and soy. After cooking on salt, curing with salt, the only thing left is to cook INSIDE salt - Spencer's Salt Crusted Prime Rib is a game changer, flavourful, bone-in beef that he seasons with a big, bold Dijon mustard, rosemary and horseradish rub before encasing it completely in a classic salt crust and sending it to the grill.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chocolate on the barbecue? That's right. Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode as he grills a crispy coconut-cacao crust and serves it with sweet chili dipping sauce. Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate crumble over the top.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Garbanzo Beans and Grapefruit
programme.desc: In this fast-paced episode, host Theresa Visintin uses two unlikely ingredients that start with the letter "G," garbanzo beans and grapefruit! First up, Theresa cooks socca, a savoury garbanzo bean pancake recipe, and infuses it with Mediterranean flavours. To make her batter, Theresa combines chickpea flour with salty olives, sweet red pepper, and fresh basil. Once the batter is ready to go, she fries the savoury crepe. Next up, Theresa balances tart grapefruit with a sweet buttery lobster tail. But that's not sweet enough for Theresa! She prepares sabayon, a delicate honey custard that melts in your mouth. Finally, Theresa shows us how to make a mouth-watering dish by combining grapefruit and garbanzo.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Chicken and corn are the key players in this letter “C” challenge. Chef Lauren Gulyas prepares one of her favourite Italian dishes, chicken Marsala. Using garlic, shallots, and white wine, Chef Lauren whips up a rich Marsala sauce that is nutty and floral in flavour. Next, she transforms corn into a creamy polenta topping for her Shepard’s pie...with a twist! Sautéing onion, garlic, and lean ground beef, she uses Worcestershire sauce and tomato paste to give the pie filling an extra flavour boost. Once she finishes those dishes, Chef Lauren creates a mouth-watering recipe that combines both chicken and corn.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: After picking the letter "L," Chef Robert Jewell takes on lamb and licorice in this ingredient challenge. He starts with aromatic Moroccan lamb riblets, an appetizer that will make you want this spicy dish as your main course too. Next, Robert takes it up a notch by showing us how to make licorice - yes, the candy! He brings coconut oil, brown sugar, creamed coconut, and molasses to boil before skillfully adding flour and anise to make sweet, chewy coconut licorice. Finally, Robert concocts the perfect recipe that combines succulent lamb with sweet licorice.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Host Theresa Visintin creates savoury meals in this letter "R" challenge featuring radicchios and raisins. First, Theresa chops up bold and bitter radicchios, grilling them until the edges are a crispy golden brown and perfect for a warm wedge salad. Then, she tosses fried pancetta and earthy portobello mushrooms in a luxurious champagne vinegar and pours it over the crispy radicchio. Theresa tops this warm salad with creamy crumbled goat's cheese. For her next dish, Theresa prepares a rum raisin sauce using golden sultana raisins, dark rum, and fresh orange. Theresa pours the sauce over succulent ham. Is your mouth watering yet? Finally, Theresa combines radicchio and raisin into a colourful and delicious side dish.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: It's all about pork and peanuts, today's challenge is the letter "P." Chef Lauren Gulyas serves up an old school favourite, smothered pork chops. Using a blend of savoury ingredients, and with the help of her cast iron pan, Chef Lauren provides us with tips on how to keep your pork tender and tasty. Next, it's time for a West African peanut soup. Drizzling garlic, ginger and onions with extra virgin olive oil and letting them sizzle in a frying pan until the onions are soft brings out a sweetness that lends itself beautifully to the salty, earthy taste of peanuts. To finish, Chef Lauren puts an Asian twist on a southern classic, when she combines the two ingredients.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin and Lucy travel up and down the country visiting houses sold under the hammer. Lucy catches up with developers who had planned to build several houses on one plot in Surrey while Martin looks around terraced houses in Staffordshire and Cumbria.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin and Lucy are in the south of England and Northern Ireland looking at properties sold under the hammer. A flat, a Victorian house with seven separate rental rooms and a 1960s terrace all get renovated- but which one stands to make the most profit?

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A one bedroom flat in London, a Kent maisonette by the sea and a Victorian terrace in Crewe go under the hammer at auction. They all need renovating they all get new kitchens and bathrooms but do their new owners stand to make a profit?

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A studio flat in London, a cottage by a Derbyshire canal and a mid-terrace in South Wales all go under the Hammer. Martin and Lucy can see potential in all of the properties and have plenty of ideas on how to add value.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A terraced house in Burnley in Lancashire, a bungalow on a big plot in Paddock Wood in Kent and a semi in Chaddesden in Derby all go under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin and Lucy travel the country visiting properties sold under the hammer. A large barn in Upwell in Norfolk, a period property in Folkestone in Kent and a house in Chesterton in Newcastle-under-Lyme are all in need of major TLC.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin and Lucy look around a trio of terraces. But there is a twist - one of the homes in Stoke is an enormous property which Martin thinks started out life as three terraced houses.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Two friends who buy a house in Cumbria's Maryport discover a bonus room they never knew existed. Elsewhere developers tackle a terraced house in Burton-upon-Trent, while in Deal in Kent an ambitious redevelopment of an ambulance hall gets under way.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A mid-terrace house near Birmingham, a flat in London's vibrant Maida Hill and a bit of land in Scotland's historic Dunfermline catch the attention of property developers who have grand ideas - but will they go according to plan?

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Property renovation series. Featuring a former railway worker's cottage in Feniton in Devon, a terraced house in Stoke and a former Methodist chapel in Somercotes in Derbyshire.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin and Lucy visit a house in Congleton in Cheshire, a one-bedroom flat in Willesden in London and a former ambulance station in Port Talbot in Wales.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: An enormous semi in Rotherham, an impressive former chapel in Fraddon in Cornwall and a tiny terraced house in Putney in London go under the hammer. But which one could command a price tag of well over a million pounds after it has been spruced up?

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Lucy looks at a one-bedroom flat next to a train line in London with a hefty guide price. Martin visits projects in Abertillary and Walderslade.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Lucy meets a primary school teacher who buys a basement flat in East Dulwich in London which looks perfect, but she soon discovers has a major issue. Will she be able to sort it out on her budget and go to the top of the class?

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: It's a family affair for all three property development projects in Port Talbot, Wimbledon and Telford. A father and daughter, cousins and a father and his two stepsons tackle projects bought at auction from just over 20,000 to more than 1.2 million.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Lucy enjoys a day by the seaside visiting a two-bedroom maisonette a few steps from the water in Kent's Leysdown-on-Sea, while Martin has a look at a terraced house in Cymmer in the Welsh Valleys and a two-bedroom mid-terrace in Penkhull near Stoke.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin looks around a terraced house in West Bromwich and another in Telford, while Lucy checks on progress 18 months after she first visited a bungalow on a large plot near Gillingham in Kent.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin visits a two-bedroom flat in Budleigh Salterton and a three-bed terrace in Northern Ireland, which needs a new lease of life. Lucy meets the buyer of a plot of land in London, who has big plans for its future.

programme.desc: Lucy catches up with a developer she met three years ago. This time he has an ambitious project turning two flats in a Victorian house in Hounslow into three. Martin meets two first-time developers working on projects in Glasgow and the West Midlands.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Property renovation series. A flat in Edinburgh, a 1930s terraced house in Bromley in Kent and a five-bedroom house in Exeter in danger of falling down are sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer

programme.desc: Martin and Lucy go flat-tastic looking around buildings which developers hope will create around a dozen flats. The properties sold under the hammer are in Stoke in Staffordshire, Bexleyheath in Kent and Gunnislake in Cornwall.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Arizona"
programme.desc: Lisa spontaneously joins a sober dance party on a mountain top in Sedona, and meets spiritual Van Lifers who have dramatically changed their entire existence, including former NFL player Joe Hawley, and a transformative breathwork practitioner.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Los Angeles based electronic music producer and DJ Moe Espinosa, aka Drumcell, has created sonic soundscapes which tell cinematic stories with his music. Moe has always tried to avoid commercialism and by having a vision that remains independent.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Detroit"
programme.desc: Punk rocker Jon-Mikal formed his band The Idiot Kids as a way to deal with his sexuality. After coming out to his family at 21, he uses writing and his stage performance as a form of therapy.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "New York"
programme.desc: Rapper Shiniqua, aka Pretty Little Monster, juggles motherhood while trying to avoid the trappings of Instagram fame. Her passion is writing rap lyrics and always tries to keep it real.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Big Wave World Tour"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Big Wave World Tour
programme.desc: Trevor Carlson puts everything on the line to chase monster waves from Maui, Hawaii to Ensenada, Mexico.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Skimboarding Jaws"
programme.desc: Brad Domke aims for the big wave surfing history books by skimming the big waves of Pe’ahi.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Pe’ahi"
programme.desc: Will Skudin and Keali’i Mamala deal with the trials and tribulations of life as traveling big wave surfers.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: Marilia's Irish journey, meeting land enthusiasts, explored scenic spots, encounters with Ellie and Hazel, vegan delights at Cornucopia, and concluded with a reflective sunset in the Wicklow Mountains, highlighting a strong community spirit.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Bali"
programme.desc: Marilia's Bali journey, focused on purification rituals, blended culture, healing, and adventure. From Tirta Empul's cleansing to exploring Ubud, embracing nature, and local traditions, she found serenity, capturing precious moments in her odyssey.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Malaysia"
programme.desc: Marilia explores social support at Kechara Soup Kitchen, tries Acroyoga, enjoys plant-based food at Nomad Urban Cafe, and visits Melawati Canine Sanctuary. Her experiences emphasize the importance of helping others and maintaining life balance.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Lisbon"
programme.desc: Two street artists are fusing their styles together in one of the world's finest cities, Lisbon.The challenge is left hanging by a thread when disaster strikes.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "London"
programme.desc: Two legendary street artists team up in London for the ultimate Street Art Challenge. Things get out of hand between the two as it turns into a street fight.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Ibiza"
programme.desc: Three artists head to Ibiza to face their street art challenge; bringing the local community together through art. But the Mediterranean sun is unforgiving.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Newfoundland"
programme.desc: Following Newfoundland’s rail history, Michael explores cod fishing, grape-free wine, and meadow cliffs by ATV.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Nova Scotia"
programme.desc: Exploring Canada’s railway roots, Michael discovers Nova Scotia through Indigenous dance, log rolling with a champion, and surfing iconic waves.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "New Brunswick"
programme.desc: Michael explores New Brunswick by land, sea, and air. He traverses historic bridges and scenic coasts before taking to the skies.

programme.title: A Simple Path: The Worldwide Ride
programme.desc: Skateboarding and its do it yourself lifestyle has permeated into the worlds of art, music, and fashion. The constant progression and search for the new, attracts unique individuals from all walks of life.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Inventive Architecture"
programme.desc: Explore a collection of houses that have one thing in common - the designers have come up with inventive ideas and radical approaches to solving everyday design issues. It's both clever and inspiring with plenty of take home tips for the home renovator.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Little Gems"
programme.desc: Modern city living has it challenges mostly around space. Johanna and Pete look at homes that make the most out of the space they have. These little gems may change the way you think about living in small spaces.

programme.title: A Simple Path S1 - "Cape Town"
programme.desc: Cape Town South Africa is about vintage cameras, fish and chips with seals, botany inspired apparel, The Dollfins, a hand poke tattoo, forest foraged mushrooms and drag queens skating a barrier on Table mountain.

programme.title: A Simple Path S1 - "Johannesburg"
programme.desc: Empowered in Jozi the city of gold South Africa with the kids from Skateistan, leftfield artists and photographers, streetside Kotas, volcano sessions, Slappy screen printing, a backyard ramp and skating through an art gallery.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - "Bikes and Boats"
programme.desc: Jess and her ride crew navigate the stunning but rugged Konkan Coast, switching between bikes and boats while juggling luggage, riders and a lost phone. Gearshifter unexpectedly joins the team as they race toward Mumbai, determined to get Pulak to the city in time to visit his family.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - "Train Troubles"
programme.desc: Jess and the team arrive in Mumbai, soaking in the city’s vibrant culture. After saying goodbye to Pulak, the team scrambles to catch their trains to Ahmedabad and Jodhpur. Split up along the way, they reunite in Jaisalmer where they experience quintessential Rajasthan, riding across the iconic dunes of the Thar Desert.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "England and Wales: Castles, Baths, and Tubing"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 England and Wales: Castles, Baths, and Tubing
programme.desc: Cross the English Channel to a land of knights and castles. Tour London’s Big Ben on a double-decker bus and explore historic cathedrals and baths.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Beaches, Castles, and the Happiest Place on Earth"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Beaches, Castles, and the Happiest Place on Earth
programme.desc: Find happiness in the sun-drenched Florida Keys, trek through the rugged Scottish Highlands, and discover the stunning coastal waterfalls of Croatia.

programme.title: Car & Country Quest S1 - "Ashique's Italy"
programme.desc: Ashique surprises the team with Vespa rides along the coast, adapts plans with an aquarium visit, and arranges a Fiat 500 countryside drive. The day ends with relaxation at a Roman spa.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Las Vegas"
programme.desc: Las Vegas is home to a hot rod car club community which over the decades has been connected to the rise of rockabilly music. Through Luke Metz and his band, Shanda & The Howlers, we learn how this bond between fashion, music and cars was created.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "US Virgin Islands"
programme.desc: The US Virgin Islands is one of the most popular destinations in the Caribbean - how about their cuisine? With a true blue Jeep 4x4, Sashi explores the chains of islands, learning stories of local cuisines, brand new distilleries and much more

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "French Polynesia Part 1"
programme.desc: Sashi is in a strip of islands in the middle of nowhere - French Polynesia! He scours the island of Bora Bora in search of a real local’s meal but goes empty handed. Switching gears, he looks for respite at the legendary Four Seasons Bora Bora where he embarks on a deep-sea fishing run with local fishermen, catching yellowtail tuna.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "French Polynesia Part 2"
programme.desc: With luxury done and dusted, Sashi comes across a story of resurgence during a pandemic, with the story of St. James, one of the island’s newest restaurants. Feeling like he did Bora Bora justice, Sashi island hops over to Mo’orea where he takes the quirkiest food tour of his life; baguettes with chow mein, ice-cream pizza, Chinese dumplings!? The island of Mo’orea does quirky food right!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "Dubai: 24 hour layover in the desert"
programme.sub-title: S03 : E06 Dubai: 24 hour layover in the desert
programme.desc: Sashi is doing something he’s never done! A layover style episode. He’s got just 24 hours in the desert metropolis of Dubai. After seeking out the hive of human activity at Dubai’s bustling souks, Sashi does the absolute opposite, by venturing out in the desert.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Coconut"
programme.desc: Explore the boundless potential of coconuts with Lauren as she reinvents a calamari dish using coconut flesh, offering a taste experience that will leave you in awe and redefine your culinary perceptions.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Banana"
programme.desc: Indulge in the versatile world of bananas as Lauren skillfully crafts recipes, from banana flour sourdough bread to twist-infused pancakes, offering a tantalizing experience that showcases the endless possibilities of this humble fruit.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Potato"
programme.desc: Lauren explores the culinary possibilities of the humble potato. She demonstrates how to make perfect crispy potato wedges, a hearty potato and vegetable curry, and homemade gnocchi recipe that is hard to beat.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Matthieu Dupuis Baumal – Chateau de la Gaude"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Matthieu Dupuis Baumal – Chateau de la Gaude
programme.desc: In this program we’ll explore the story of the skilled Chef Matthieu Dupuis Baumal, his style of cooking and how he took his team to greatness in only a couple of months! We’ll also visit one of the best olive oil producers in the world.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Amandine Chaignot – Pouliche"
programme.desc: In this program Amandine Chaignot demonstrates the extent of her talent, serving refined vegetarian-focused cuisine. We’ll get to know her secrets for stimulating flavors and the principles behind her raw, refined French cuisine.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Antonin Bonnet – Quinsou"
programme.desc: In this program we’ll get an insight of the importance of quality, as Antonin sources his ingredients with diligence. Making careful use of all elements, his kitchen manages to match sustainability with elegance and excellence.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "The Herbal Way of Life"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "Xilingol"
programme.desc: In Xilin Gol, the local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia.Just join in this visual trip!

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "Kunming"
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "The Taste of Home"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 The Taste of Home
programme.desc: Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood.

programme.title: Ainsley's Market Menu S1 - "Willunga"
programme.desc: In a South Australian town, Ainsley gathers rare pork loin for a spicy jerk dish, plus fresh berries and cream for a seasonal market dessert.

programme.title: Ainsley's Market Menu S1 - "Warrnambool"
programme.desc: At a coastal market in Victoria, Ainsley cooks up soy beef lollipops, a fresh fig and mozzarella plate, and jam-topped British drop scones.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4 - "Serbia Part 1"

programme.desc: Discover the delicious and nutritious world of tofu with Lauren as she experiments with various textures and flavors, pushing the soybean to its limits to create amazing dishes like Scramble tofu and the sweet-spicy delight of Tahu Gejrot.

programme.desc: Ainsley visits a culturally diverse global market, cooking a special vegetarian curry for a local farmer's 85th birthday and unique lamb sliders.

programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. programme.title: World Heritages in China: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing
programme.desc: Water has always been the heartbeat of human civilization, nurturing the cities it weaves through. From the first drops that carved out its waterways to the thriving metropolis we see today, Wuxi’s story is inseparable from the grand canal. This is the story of a city born of water. In this episode, we uncover how the waters have shaped Wuxi’s identity.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chaozhou
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran He and Angela Fu are in Chaozhou, South China. They're on a quest to discover the secrets of its success, for Chaozhou is famed for its wealthy merchant guilds and its homegrown Teochew cuisine, which enjoys global recognition.From working as part-timers in a beef hotpot restaurant, to learning about tea ceremony and shadowing a master of Teochew cuisine, our hosts discover the best way to learn about Chaozhou, is through its food.

programme.desc: The documentary “Shared Roots in Wrestling” follows a young wrestler from Tianjin as he journeys to Inner Mongolia to explore the shared heritage of Chinese-style wrestling and Bökh, the region’s national wrestling tradition. programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: World Heritages in China: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing
programme.desc: Water has always been the heartbeat of human civilization, nurturing the cities it weaves through. From the first drops that carved out its waterways to the thriving metropolis we see today, Wuxi’s story is inseparable from the grand canal. This is the story of a city born of water. In this episode, we uncover how the waters have shaped Wuxi’s identity.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chaozhou
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran He and Angela Fu are in Chaozhou, South China. They're on a quest to discover the secrets of its success, for Chaozhou is famed for its wealthy merchant guilds and its homegrown Teochew cuisine, which enjoys global recognition.From working as part-timers in a beef hotpot restaurant, to learning about tea ceremony and shadowing a master of Teochew cuisine, our hosts discover the best way to learn about Chaozhou, is through its food.

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations,...

programme.title: Dreams beyond the acrobatic stage
programme.desc: Many young acrobats from across China have gathered in Wuqiao, Cangzhou in north China's Hebei Province, with one shared goal: to dazzle audiences with their talents and stunt skills. They usually starts to train at an early age, shouldering the hopes and support of their families and teachers to become successful performers. We followed three of these young performers to show you how incredibly talented they are.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chongqing
programme.desc: Welcome to Chongqing, China's largest city. Located in the country's southwest, it straddles two mighty rivers and is famed for its extraordinary skyline, with high-rises mushrooming out of the hills and vertigo-inducing bridges.But Tianran He and Angela Fu are here for the food: From xiaomian noodles and Jianghu cuisine to the city's most famous dish: Chongqing hotpot, our hosts take on the spicy, numbing and scintillating aromas of Chongqing cuisine. We promise you: Chongqing will electrify your senses and tantalise your taste buds.

programme.title: Foodwise: Veggie Beijing
programme.desc: Beijing is a 3000-year old metropolis home to a dizzying array of culinary traditions, not least of which is vegetarian cuisine. For Beijingers, eating vegetarian is the best way to welcome spring. In this episode, Tianran and Angela take up the challenge: From simple home cooking utilizing spring flowers and leaves, to the extravagant mock-meat masterpieces of imperial cuisine, and international dishes well-known to the vegetarian community, our hosts discover a plethora of plant-based options to be found amongst the historic alleys and skyscrapers of China's capital.

programme.title: China Highly Recommended: Changsha
programme.desc: Episode 1 of Travelogue's "China Highly Recommended" tells the story of Changsha, one of China's happiest cities. Following the lives of four of its foreign residents: A French executive chef, a Japanese podcaster, and two American teachers, we discover the reasons why they made Changsha their second home, and explore the city with them as only locals do. This episode will be released as a 30 minute travel documentary to be broadcast on CGTN's television channel and social media platform, along with a series of video clips and photos

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations,...

programme.title: Foodwise: Chongqing
programme.desc: Welcome to Chongqing, China's largest city. Located in the country's southwest, it straddles two mighty rivers and is famed for its extraordinary skyline, with high-rises mushrooming out of the hills and vertigo-inducing bridges.But Tianran He and Angela Fu are here for the food: From xiaomian noodles and Jianghu cuisine to the city's most famous dish: Chongqing hotpot, our hosts take on the spicy, numbing and scintillating aromas of Chongqing cuisine. We promise you: Chongqing will electrify your senses and tantalise your taste buds.

programme.title: Foodwise: Veggie Beijing
programme.desc: Beijing is a 3000-year old metropolis home to a dizzying array of culinary traditions, not least of which is vegetarian cuisine. For Beijingers, eating vegetarian is the best way to welcome spring. In this episode, Tianran and Angela take up the challenge: From simple home cooking utilizing spring flowers and leaves, to the extravagant mock-meat masterpieces of imperial cuisine, and international dishes well-known to the vegetarian community, our hosts discover a plethora of plant-based options to be found amongst the historic alleys and skyscrapers of China's capital.

programme.title: China Highly Recommended: Changsha
programme.desc: Episode 1 of Travelogue's "China Highly Recommended" tells the story of Changsha, one of China's happiest cities. Following the lives of four of its foreign residents: A French executive chef, a Japanese podcaster, and two American teachers, we discover the reasons why they made Changsha their second home, and explore the city with them as only locals do. This episode will be released as a 30 minute travel documentary to be broadcast on CGTN's television channel and social media platform, along with a series of video clips and photos

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. programme.title: Dreams beyond the acrobatic stage
programme.desc: Many young acrobats from across China have gathered in Wuqiao, Cangzhou in north China's Hebei Province, with one shared goal: to dazzle audiences with their talents and stunt skills. They usually starts to train at an early age, shouldering the hopes and support of their families and teachers to become successful performers. We followed three of these young performers to show you how incredibly talented they are.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chongqing
programme.desc: Welcome to Chongqing, China's largest city. Located in the country's southwest, it straddles two mighty rivers and is famed for its extraordinary skyline, with high-rises mushrooming out of the hills and vertigo-inducing bridges.But Tianran He and Angela Fu are here for the food: From xiaomian noodles and Jianghu cuisine to the city's most famous dish: Chongqing hotpot, our hosts take on the spicy, numbing and scintillating aromas of Chongqing cuisine. We promise you: Chongqing will electrify your senses and tantalise your taste buds.

programme.title: Foodwise: Veggie Beijing
programme.desc: Beijing is a 3000-year old metropolis home to a dizzying array of culinary traditions, not least of which is vegetarian cuisine. For Beijingers, eating vegetarian is the best way to welcome spring. In this episode, Tianran and Angela take up the challenge: From simple home cooking utilizing spring flowers and leaves, to the extravagant mock-meat masterpieces of imperial cuisine, and international dishes well-known to the vegetarian community, our hosts discover a plethora of plant-based options to be found amongst the historic alleys and skyscrapers of China's capital.

programme.title: China Highly Recommended: Changsha
programme.desc: Episode 1 of Travelogue's "China Highly Recommended" tells the story of Changsha, one of China's happiest cities. Following the lives of four of its foreign residents: A French executive chef, a Japanese podcaster, and two American teachers, we discover the reasons why they made Changsha their second home, and explore the city with them as only locals do. This episode will be released as a 30 minute travel documentary to be broadcast on CGTN's television channel and social media platform, along with a series of video clips and photos

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest–tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture.This episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes — heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment — revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.1
programme.desc: Join Tianran He in Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. Fed by the Yarlung Zangbo River and abundant rainfall, this lush subtropical region is home to some of Xizan’g most unique scenery. From sacred mountains and ancient monasteries, to cruising along Nyingchi’s mother river, wandering alpine meadows and savoring stone pot chicken – a beloved local delicacy, Tianran uncovers the beauty of Nyingchi.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. programme.title: Kung fu journey up Wudang Mountains
programme.desc: Located in central China's Hubei Province, Wudang Mountains is a UNESCO World Natural and Cultural Heritage site recognized as the cradle of Wudang kung fu and as a renowned Taoist sanctuary. Every year, young students from different parts of China flock to these well-established kung fu academies to experience a childhood like no other. Li Weimu and Li Muzi study at two separate kung fu academies, and are following their own paths at Wudang Mountains.

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Pingyao Hand-Polished Lacquer Art
programme.desc: Pingyao is an old town with a history of over 2,700 years in the north of China, in Shanxi Province. The rich cultural heritage it built up over the centuries eventually gave rise to a very special art—Tuiguang lacquerware. This hand-polished lacquerware, unique to Pingyao, is recognized as one of the four representative lacquerwares of China.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a...

programme.title: Kung fu journey up Wudang Mountains
programme.desc: Located in central China's Hubei Province, Wudang Mountains is a UNESCO World Natural and Cultural Heritage site recognized as the cradle of Wudang kung fu and as a renowned Taoist sanctuary. Every year, young students from different parts of China flock to these well-established kung fu academies to experience a childhood like no other. Li Weimu and Li Muzi study at two separate kung fu academies, and are following their own paths at Wudang Mountains.

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Pingyao Hand-Polished Lacquer Art
programme.desc: Pingyao is an old town with a history of over 2,700 years in the north of China, in Shanxi Province. The rich cultural heritage it built up over the centuries eventually gave rise to a very special art—Tuiguang lacquerware. This hand-polished lacquerware, unique to Pingyao, is recognized as one of the four representative lacquerwares of China.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes.In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly...

programme.title: Breathing new life into century-old Yueju Opera
programme.desc: Yueju Opera is one of the five major Chinese operas. It is skillful in narration and sentiment and is popular across China. This timeless form of intangible cultural heritage now has new apprentices. We followed a young duo of Yueju Opera performers: eleven-year-old Wang Yuhan and her stage partner, nine-year-old Huang Xinru in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, as they shared kindred spirits in inheriting the performing art of Yueju Opera.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in...

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Changbai Mountain
programme.desc: An unforgettable adventure awaits amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Changbai Mountain! Embark on a trek through pristine birch forests, marvel at the majestic power of the world's deepest volcanic waterfall, and uncover hidden gems along the way. Indulge in soaking in natural hot springs and experience exhilarating rafting down mountain streams, all leading to the final destination: Tianchi Lake, a heavenly oasis nestled in the clouds. Join the Travelogue team as we delve into the beauty of Changbai Mountain.
